Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at NovaHealth is enthusiastic about Redwood's runtime and the cost/latency profile you showed. Procurement needs two things to close the PO: a finalized DPA we can sign, and the supporting evidence pack for our Security team (SOC 2 summary, pen test overview, and a short explanation of subprocessors and cross-border transfers).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which subprocessors process customer data and where data leaves the EU/US boundary?
- Can Redwood provide a one-page summary of the SOC 2 scope and the latest pen test highlights we can share with our InfoSec folks?

We'd like to have the signed DPA and evidence by EOD Thursday if possible — is that realistic? If you prefer DocuSign, we can accept that flow.

Appreciate it,
Anna

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: DPA redlines v2 + suggested audit clause language

Priya / Karthik — attaching redlines_v2_DPA.docx (internal). Summary of changes we want to present to NovaHealth: 

- Audit rights: We propose a scoped audit right limited to SOC 2 evidence and a single on-site review per 12 months, conducted by a mutually agreed third party, with 30 days' notice.
- Subprocessors: We will include the current subprocessors and commit to 30 days' notice before new major subprocessors are engaged; minor infra upgrades are listed in the subprocessors appendix.
- Data transfers: Standard SCCs for EU transfers plus a description of encryption & key management.
- Pen test results: high-level summary only (no raw vuln data) — provide remediation attestations where applicable.

Laura, please confirm SOC 2 phrasing below is consistent with our independent auditor's report. Soojin, can you confirm the subprocessors list and whether any new vendor will require additional legal review?

Internal note: keep the audit scope narrow to avoid excessive customer obligations; we will provide artifacts rather than full access unless escalated.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redlines_v2_DPA.docx (internal)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA redlines v2 + suggested audit clause language

Thanks — attached two artifacts: SOC2-Type2-summary-2025.pdf and external-pen-test-summary-2026.txt. Short answers to Anna's questions:

- Subprocessors: Current list: Cloud infra (GCP us-east1, eu-west1), Metrics provider (Datastats), CDN (FastNet). Data leaves region for model inference caching (US <-> EU) under SCCs; primary customer data residency is configurable per account.
- Pen test: We include an executive summary and remediation dates; we do not share raw logs or exploit code.
- Audit requests: For routine procurement checks we can provide the SOC 2 summary + pen test exec summary and a signed attestation. On-site or full-scope audits go through our legal/CS process and require a scoped statement of work.

I have uploaded artifacts to the shared Drive folder (see link below) and attached the two files for quick review.

Karthik
Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-summary-2025.pdf; external-pen-test-summary-2026.txt
